title: Bounded Prime Gaps OQ-01: Optimal Admissible Tuples and Gap Bound Hierarchy

problemStatement.formal: \min\{D : \exists \text{ admissible } k\text{-tuple of diameter } D, \text{ Maynard-Tao applies}\}
problemStatement.plain: What is the minimum achievable prime gap bound H below 246 without assuming Elliott-Halberstam? The Polymath 8b theorem gives H ≤ 246 unconditionally, and H ≤ 12 conditionally on EH. The open question is whether the unconditional bound can be improved. The formalization establishes the admissible tuple framework: minimum diameters for k-tuples (2→2, 3→6, 5→12) and their connection to gap bounds.
whyMatters: Bridges the gap between the proven H≤246 bound and the Twin Prime Conjecture (H=2)
Formalizes the key combinatorial objects (admissible tuples) at the heart of sieve theory
Establishes the mathematical framework for understanding why the EH-conditional bound is exactly 12

H ≤ 12 (conditional on EH) - formalized as axiom bounded_gaps_conditional_EH

Minimum diameter of admissible 2-tuple = 2 (connecting to TPC)
Minimum diameter of admissible 3-tuple = 6 ({0,2,6} is optimal)
All even 5-tuples with diameter ≤ 10 fail admissibility (by mod 3 argument)
{0,2,6,8,12} and {0,4,6,10,12} achieve the optimal diameter 12 for 5-tuples

# Knowledge Base: bounded-prime-gaps-oq-01

## Problem
Optimal admissible k-tuple diameters and the gap bound hierarchy.

## Proof File
`proofs/Proofs/BoundedPrimeGapsOQ01.lean` - 438 lines, 0 sorries

## Key Results
- Minimum diameter: 2-tuple=2, 3-tuple=6, 5-tuple=12
- All even 5-tuples with diameter ≤ 10 fail mod 3
- Gap bound hierarchy: 2 ≤ H_opt ≤ 246

## Techniques
- `decide` for concrete Finset cardinality computations
- `interval_cases` for small case analysis
- `omega` + `rcases` for value case splits
